g.text: Global activity polarity through site competition
A/D: paths in activity-vector space. All panels show 0–4000 native units; full records reach 14,000.
Width-3 cues: WP peak 0.1; Goryachev 6.4; Holmes 1. Native input/time scales are model-specific.
C40 Holmes d12/d16 share the exact full basal state; other size comparisons change material, architecture and routes.
